reviewOutcome: Official regional and national cadastral/map custodians were found, but no qualifying public parcel-polygon response or safe retained geometry sample was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Kazakh/Russian discovery was performed and recorded in the city record. The official Turkestan geoportal could not return a response; AIS GZK viewer HTML/config was retrieved and exposed a parcel proxy candidate, but anonymous metadata requests returned 404. The EGKN reference had a TLS verification failure and the digital-land portal timed out. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe field request was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: The Turkestan Region geoportal and Turkestan Region land-relations authority are local/regional custodians. AIS GZK is the national state land-cadastre viewer; the city notice documents transition to the national EGKN automated workplace. These are not conflated with a verified open parcel API.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: The viewer is ArcGIS-based and its configuration names a parcel MapServer route, but the route returned 404; schema, CRS, native ID field, and bounded feature response remain unverified.
uncertainty: A zero/failed exact-point or service request is not evidence of citywide absence. The exact WUP point [43.2983623732194, 68.2609637891536] was not moved to seek a hit.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. No registry/catalog/runtime files were changed.
